details: For $n\ge2$; the domain has $n+\lfloor\log n\rfloor$ points.
proof: The defining subsets of the $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$ address bits give exactly $2^{\lfloor\log n\rfloor}$ concepts.  Substitute this cardinality and the stated domain size into the definition.
name: Log Size Ratio of Addressing
